# Campaign 2 completion review

Pre-entry clarification, 2026-09-10: see CAMPAIGN3_PRE_ENTRY_REVIEW_DISPOSITION.md
and CAMPAIGN3_ENTRY_READINESS.md. This bounded completion remains valid; it is not
whole ideal-loop or whole phenomenon coverage. Source substitutions below are

**Campaign 2 COMPLETE for the thin bounded North-Star reference scaffold**, 2026-09-09.
This is an internal adversarial qualification under the user's explicit instruction
to work independently through completion. It is not external review, a reduction
verdict, or completion of Campaign 3's retained phenomenon corpus.

The Campaign Plan's five completion conditions govern this verdict. The North Star,
canonical Architecture Map and Research Program Brief remain unchanged. Accepted
formal mathematics and permanent allocation were consumed, not redesigned. Current
evidence is in CAMPAIGN2_COGNITIVE_QUALIFICATION.md, the cognitive persistence
qualification and their fingerprint index. Prior qualified ADAPT, VAL, probe,
carriage, memory, prediction and task results remain bounded as recorded.

## Completion gate

| Campaign Plan condition | Finding |

Actual fixed registrations and governed projections own task/workspace, prediction, identity and inherited EVID/ADAPT/memory reads. Immutable instructions use373/2 field2; lifecycle owns field1, not the root. Identity alone writes415; ADAPT retains its own roots. Common140 admission and target preflight finish before any prior read, and every candidate uses B0. No generic psychological writer or public callback was introduced. |
| Complete causal path without a hand-authored psychological intermediate | PASS. Original probe produces observer-safe measurement, EVID, episode/prediction and retained task evidence. Later original deliberation produces workspace → appraisal → concern → motive → candidates → raw reasons → nuclei → arbitration → intent. Intent separately produces frozen expression/qualified identity evidence and plan → attempt → execution → actual consequence. The observer cut yields consequence SEM → OutcomeEvaluation → CharacterLearningEvidence; actual307 independently drives ADAPT. The common140 stage consolidates under separate authorities. All are genuine scheduled production outputs from empty learned S0. |

Character transformers have no truth/model/trace read capability; omniscient trace is not a character input. |
| No relevant P0 remains | PASS. Required seams, whole cognitive shape, permanent allocation and model gates preceded implementation. Immediate same-event belief reads, multi-character ordering, broad decision qualification and context modulation are explicitly absent from this accepted slice. No default resolves those decisions silently. |

The task scaffold is a research hypothesis, not a claim that task pressure is a Core
Need, that protocol count is reward, or that a two-action protocol is a general
planner. Appraisal/concern, belief, motive, reason, expression and learning remain
separately traceable even where their bounded transformation is thin.

The review challenged codec ownership, complete route output closure, preflight
ordering, source authentication, immutable mixed-root fields, exact quantization,

The implementation corrections and executed discriminators are recorded in the
cognitive qualification. The missing-I-before-priors correction is substantive;
it was fixed and tested rather than excused by later rollback. An attempted save
